2608.02287.title: SKT: Skill-Use Training at Scale via Verified Synthetic Data Generation
2608.02287.paper_summary: Agent skills have become an important mechanism for equipping language-model agents with reusable procedural knowledge. However, providing skills alone does not guarantee that current models can effectively identify, apply, and coordinate them. To improve skill-use capabilities, we introduce SKT, a verified data synthesis pipeline that constructs skill-grounded tasks and executable trajectories from large collections of agent skills. SKT selects suitable single-skill and multi-skill configurations, synthesizes tasks through rule-based and agent-based verification with feedback-guided repair, and retains only successful trajectories that substantially use every required skill. Using 2,000 public skills, SKT produces 4,000 task packages and 27,164 verified trajectories. Based on the same pipeline and a disjoint test pool, we further construct SkillEval, a held-out executable benchmark for evaluating skill use. Experiments across diverse models, benchmarks, and agent harnesses show that supervised fine-tuning on SKT-generated trajectories consistently improves skill-use performance. Verification ablations, cross-harness evaluation, and scaling experiments further demonstrate that these gains depend on high-quality supervision, extend beyond a single agent interface, and increase with broader skill coverage. Together, these results establish verified data synthesis as an effective and scalable approach for skill-use training.
2608.02287.paper_summary_zh: 代理技能已成為為語言模型代理裝備可重用程序知識的重要機制。<lb/>然而，僅提供技能並不保證當前模型能有效識別、應用和協調這些技能。<lb/>為了改善技能使用能力，我們引入了SKT，一個經過驗證的數據合成管道，它從大量代理技能中構建以技能為基礎的任務和可執行的軌跡。<lb/>SKT選擇合適的單技能和多技能配置，通過基於規則和基於代理的驗證進行合成任務，並進行反饋引導的修復，僅保留實質性使用每個所需技能的成功軌跡。<lb/>使用2000個公共技能，SKT生成4000個任務包和27164條經過驗證的軌跡。<lb/>基於相同的管道和一個不重疊的測試池，我們進一步構建了SkillEval，一個保留的可執行基準，用於評估技能使用。<lb/>在多種模型、基準和代理工具中進行的實驗表明，對SKT生成的軌跡進行監督性微調始終能改善技能使用性能。<lb/>驗證消融、交叉工具評估和擴展實驗進一步證明，這些增益依賴於高質量的監督，超越單一代理界面，並隨著更廣泛的技能覆蓋而增加。<lb/>總體而言，這些結果確立了經過驗證的數據合成作為一種有效且可擴展的技能使用訓練方法。
